newsitem.title: USA: 360 Comms Q3 cellular service revs up.
newsitem.headline: 360 Comms Q3 cellular service revs up.

text.p: 360 Communications Co, reporting higher third quarter results, said Tuesday its cellular service revenues rose to a record $271.8 million in the period from $207.5 million a year ago.
Equipment sales, however, dropped to $9.9 million from $10.3 million.
"Our fundamental wireless business remains strong, and we're pleased with our solid performance," Dennis Foster, president, said in a statement.

"As we enter the final quarter of our first year as an independent company, we continue to aggressively increase revenues, capitalize on our competitive strengths, and leverage the infrastructure that we have in place," he said.
360 Communications Co was spun off from Sprint Corp.
360 said its market penetration was 8.84 percent at the end of the third quarter, representing a annualized penetration gain of 1.92 percent for the period.
